Careers

Join the Team Behind the Industry’s Leading Hybrid Cloud Data Platform

CTERA Networks provides the industry’s leading Enterprise File Services Platform and offers a high-growth, innovative environment with an informal, collegial atmosphere. We are growing fast and are always looking for excellent talent. You can apply for an open position today, or send your resume to careers@ctera.com.

Our Values

We believe in thinking big, collaborating and empowering each other to build the most scalable and innovative products in our industry. We’re a team of fast learners who work hard!

Company Culture

We’re a team of dedicated, innovative-thinkers who are here to revolutionize the way enterprises secure, manage and share data.

Perks & Benefits

  • Health & Wellness Plans
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Fun & Social Offsite Events
  • Fast Growth For Rapid Career Advancement
  • Ongoing Training & Professional Development
  • Awesome Swag
